description: This file defines classes related to grain state management with versioning and metadata in Orleans, including classes for state with metadata and ETag support, used for log-view consistency and storage.

classes.name: GrainStateWithMetaDataAndETag
classes.description: A class extending grain state with versioning metadata and ETag for log-view consistency.

classes.name: GrainStateWithMetaData
classes.description: A class extending grain state with versioning metadata, including a write vector for duplicate append avoidance.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the object information to a string representation.

methods.name: GetBit
methods.description: Retrieves a specific bit from the write vector based on the replica ID.

methods.name: FlipBit
methods.description: Toggles a specific bit in the write vector for a given replica and returns the new bit state.
